_note: Switzerland abolished all industrial tariffs on 1 January 2024, so a car pays no customs duty from anywhere — the old CHF 12–15 per 100 kg is dead law. What remains is the 4% automobile tax and 8.1% VAT, both charged on the price actually paid, which is why Switzerland is computed and not estimated. The CO2 sanction exists but does not reach an ordinary used import.

co2Sanction._note: Only for a car that is effectively new: registered abroad 12 months ago or less, or between 6 and 12 months ago with under 5 000 km. Art. 17d Abs. 3 CO2-Verordnung. The target curve and the franc-per-gram are re-set every year — M(t−2) is the Swiss average kerb weight two years back — so this block wants re-reading each January.

fees._note: Only the federal amounts are fixed nationwide. Cantonal registration, plates and the technical check differ in all 26 cantons and no national figure exists, so they are a market range and labelled an estimate.
